title: How to Buy Qatar Airways Privilege Club Avios
body:
Australian Frequent Flyer
Australian Frequent Flyer - Tips, Tricks and Chat for Australian Frequent Flyers
Qatar Airways “Qsuite” Business Class. Photo: Qatar Airways.
Qatar Airways Privilege Club is one of seven loyalty programs that uses Avios as its points currency. Like British Airways Club , Iberia Plus and Finnair Plus , Qatar Airways’ loyalty program also sells Avios directly to members.
By buying Avios cheaply and redeeming them for high-value rewards, you could save substantial amounts of money on Business Class flights. This includes the legendary Qatar Airways Qsuite .
Since you can transfer Avios between programs on a 1:1 basis , it makes sense to buy Avios from whichever program is offering the best price. That won’t always be Qatar Airways Privilege Club, but it could be when a discount or bonus is running.
How to buy Qatar Avios
You can purchase or gift Qatar Privilege Club Avios on the Qatar Airways website.
The minimum purchase is 1,000 Avios, and you can purchase in various increments:
1,000 – 26,000 Avios in 1,000 Avios increments
26,000 – 100,000 Avios in 2,000 Avios increments
100,000 – 250,000 Avios in 5,000 Avios increments
The maximum purchase limit is 250,000 Avios before any bonuses.
If you register your account in Australia, Qatar Airways lets you buy Avios in AUD. Note that the prices may fluctuate slightly, depending on exchange rate changes.
Qatar Airways charges AU$42.84 for the lowest amount of 1,000 Avios. However, the rate gets cheaper as you purchase more. Purchasing 26,000 Avios or more in one transaction will get you the best price, at $35.19 per 1,000 Avios (before any discounts or bonuses).
Qatar Airways Avios expire after 36 months of account inactivity. Note that transferring Avios from one “flavour” to another counts as account activity and will prevent your Avios from expiring.
Special deals for buying Qatar Airways Avios
Qatar Airways Privilege Club regularly offers promotions, usually bonuses, for buying Avios.
During the current promotion running from 19-25 August 2026, Qatar Airways Avios are available with up to a ~20-50% bonus. The exact bonus amounts are different for each account. You can check your personal offer by logging into your Privilege Club account.
You can purchase Qatar Avios via the Qatar Airways website .
Note: Australian Frequent Flyer may receive a commission when buying points via this link.
The exact bonus amount depends on how many Avios you buy, with a higher bonus for larger purchases. On accounts being offered up to 50% bonus, for example, the levels are:
Buy 3000-10,000 Avios to get a 20% bonus
Buy 11,000-20,000 Avios to get a 40% bonus
Buy 20,000-250,000 Avios to get a 50% bonus
Past offers on buying Qatar Avios
The best ever offer we’ve previously seen on Qatar Avios was a bonus of up to 70% in May 2025.

As an example, if you bought the maximum of 250,000 Avios during this promotion with a 50% bonus, you would get 375,000 Qatar Airways Avios for AU$8,797.50 (in AUD). This means you’d be buying Qatar Avios for ~2.35 cents each.
Targeted offers
Qatar Airways also sometimes applies a targeted bonus or discount to individual accounts. However, you may not receive any notification about an exclusive offer – you’ll have to check on the buy points page.
Converting Amex Membership Rewards Points to Qatar Airways Avios
If you have an Australian credit card that earns American Express Membership Rewards Points, you can also transfer these to get Qatar Avios. From 15 December 2025, Amex Membership Rewards Points transfer to Qatar Airways Avios at a 3:1 rate.

Redeeming Qatar Avios
You can redeem Qatar Airways Avios for flights on Qatar Airways and Oneworld airlines, as well as various other partners including Virgin Australia, JetBlue, Philippine Airlines and Airlink.
Qatar Airways is the only airline in the Avios “family” that partners with JetBlue. Photo: JetBlue.
Award flights on some partner airlines appear online. If you can’t book online, you could call Qatar Airways to book… or if you want to book on a Oneworld airline, you could alternatively just transfer your Avios to British Airways Club and book on the British Airways website.
You can get great value by using Qatar Airways Avios for Qatar Airways flights. The airline has lower Avios redemption rates on their own flights, compared to partner airlines, such as 90,000 Avios for one-way Business Class from Australia to Europe. There is also more availability through Qatar Airways Privilege Club for its own flights, versus partner programs such as Virgin Australia Velocity .
A Qatar Airways Airbus A380. Photo: Qatar Airways.
Qatar Airways recently made it much more difficult to redeem Privilege Club Avios for anyone other than the account holder. To redeem Qatar Airways Privilege Club Avios for someone else, you must add them to your “My List” or the Family & Friends program.
However, you can only add someone to either of these lists, you must have credited an Avios-earning flight to Privilege Club, or hold a Qatar co-branded credit card (of which there are none in Australia. A Virgin Australia domestic flight should do the trick though!
